text_en: “At this also my heart trembles, and leaps out of its place.
text_cn: 为此我心战栗，跳离它的原位。

text_en: Listen, listen to the thunder of his voice and the rumbling that comes from his mouth.
text_cn: 你们且细听天主的怒吼声，听那从他口中发出的巨响。

text_en: Under the whole heaven he lets it loose, and his lightning to the corners of the earth.
text_cn: 他令闪电炫耀天下，使之照射地极；

text_en: After it his voice roars; he thunders with his majestic voice and he does not restrain the lightnings when his voice is heard.
text_cn: 接着是雷声隆隆，那是天主威严之声；他的巨声一响，没有什么能够阻止。

text_en: God thunders wondrously with his voice; he does great things that we cannot comprehend.
text_cn: 天主每以巨响施行奇事，做出我们莫测的事。

text_en: For to the snow he says, ‘Fall on the earth’; and the shower of rain, his heavy shower of rain,
text_cn: 他命令雪说：“落在大地上！”对暴雨说：“倾盆而降！”

text_en: serves as a sign on everyone’s hand, so that all whom he has made may know it.
text_cn: 人人都停止活动，为叫人知道，这是他的作为。

text_en: Then the animals go into their lairs and remain in their dens.
text_cn: 野兽逃回洞穴，卧于自己的窝中。

text_en: From its chamber comes the whirlwind, and cold from the scattering winds.
text_cn: 暴风来自南极密宫，严寒出自极北之地。

text_en: By the breath of God ice is given, and the broad waters are frozen fast.
text_cn: 天主嘘气成冰，使大水凝成一片。

text_en: He loads the thick cloud with moisture; the clouds scatter his lightning.
text_cn: 他使云雾满涵湿气，使闪光穿过乌云。

text_en: They turn round and round by his guidance, to accomplish all that he commands them on the face of the habitable world.
text_cn: 雷电照他的指示旋转，全照他的命令实行于地面，

text_en: Whether for correction, or for his land, or for love, he causes it to happen.
text_cn: 或为惩戒大地，或为施行恩惠。

text_en: “Hear this, O Job; stop and consider the wondrous works of God.
text_cn: 约伯啊！你且侧耳细听这事，立着沉思天主的奇事！

text_en: Do you know how God lays his command upon them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
text_cn: 你岂能知道天主怎样发命，怎样使云中电光闪烁？

text_en: Do you know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of the one whose knowledge is perfect,
text_cn: 云怎样浮动，全知者的奇妙化工，你岂能明白？

text_en: you whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the south wind?
text_cn: 当南风吹起，大地镇静时，你的衣服岂不是发暖？

text_en: Can you, like him, spread out the skies, hard as a molten mirror?
text_cn: 你岂能同他展开苍天，使它坚固如铸成的铜镜？

text_en: Teach us what we shall say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of darkness.
text_cn: 我们昏愚，不能讲话，请教训我们怎样答复他。

text_en: Should he be told that I want to speak? Did anyone ever wish to be swallowed up?
text_cn: 我说话时，能给他讲述些什么新事？世人说话后，岂算是告诉他一项新闻？

text_en: Now, no one can look on the light when it is bright in the skies, when the wind has passed and cleared them.
text_cn: 人现今看不见阳光照耀天空，除非等到风过天晴。

text_en: Out of the north comes golden splendor; around God is awesome majesty.
text_cn: 金光来自北方，天主的左右有严威可怕的异光。

text_en: The Almighty —we cannot find him; he is great in power and justice, and abundant righteousness he will not violate.
text_cn: 全能者是我们不可接近的，他的能力和正义，高超绝伦；他公义正道，决不欺压。

text_en: Therefore mortals fear him; he does not regard any who are wise in their own conceit. ”
text_cn: 所以人应敬畏他；但那心中自以为聪慧的，他却不眷顾。
